Regex error

This may have had a detrimental effect on performance for some operations.

FILES: rich/cells.py:10
ROOT CAUSE: The regex `_is_single_cell_widths` used to identify strings containing only single-width characters is incorrect or incomplete, which prevents the "fast path" in `set_cell_size` from being taken for many common single-width character strings, degrading performance.
CHANGE: Update the regex `_is_single_cell_widths` to correctly cover the intended single-width character ranges. (The exact fix depends on the intended range, but the issue identifies this regex as the source of the performance problem).
TEST: tests/test_cells.py
